title: Concept: Mongoose error detail disclosed in a response
description: A Mongoose cast error echoing the value in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The error repeats the cast path and value, which tells an attacker which fields are typed and how the model is shaped.
applicability: Deployments that render a Mongoose cast error echoing the value into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The error repeats the cast path and value, which tells an attacker which fields are typed and how the model is shaped.
